active_execution_scope.rule: Define every stage now, but only implement S0/S1 until the first scene profile, blockout, and playback gates pass.

stage_roadmap.name: UE5 scene framework and MWORKS playback base
stage_roadmap.objective: scene profile schema, object registry, collision proxy binding, MWORKS UDP/replay, UAV actor, camera, trail, radar/local-map display

stage_roadmap.name: industrial challenge hybrid single-UAV navigation scene
stage_roadmap.objective: single-UAV local perception, unknown-map replanning, obstacle avoidance, trajectory tracking, and video-ready industrial visual context
stage_roadmap.manual_gate: blockout, perception overlay, and playback review

stage_roadmap.name: tilted gate/ring aggressive attitude scene
stage_roadmap.objective: large-attitude tracking, smooth trajectory generation, controller performance display, gate/ring traversal

stage_roadmap.name: park/city patrol scene
stage_roadmap.objective: patrol/logistics style mission, path planning, local avoidance, visual demonstration in a readable outdoor environment

stage_roadmap.name: open grass wind and actuator robustness scene
stage_roadmap.objective: wind disturbance, mass/inertia perturbation, motor-efficiency degradation, sensor-noise and pulse-disturbance display
stage_roadmap.manual_gate: robustness scenario matrix review before implementation

stage_roadmap.name: indoor/maze occlusion scene
stage_roadmap.objective: wall occlusion, unknown-map memory, no-through-wall radar behavior, local replanning stress test
stage_roadmap.manual_gate: occlusion model and collision-proxy review before implementation

stage_roadmap.name: dense forest/high-density obstacle scene
stage_roadmap.objective: dense local obstacle avoidance, local map stability, performance under many repeated obstacles

stage_roadmap.name: multi-UAV formation scene
stage_roadmap.objective: leader-follower, line/triangle/diamond formation, inter-UAV distance constraints, formation obstacle avoidance
stage_roadmap.manual_gate: single-UAV scene and controller evidence must be stable first

next_recommended_task: Implement renderer_framework (S0) first, then competition_industrial_hybrid (S1). Later stages are planning contracts only until user review unlocks them.
